## What AiKOVA is
AiKOVA builds and ships operating systems for real businesses — not slideware.
Shared stack patterns: Supabase RLS, Stripe-native payments, Gov-data compliance,
FinOps, evidence vault / DOS7, AWS, multilingual voice where required.

## MCL Marketing Capture Lead bot
Floating rule-based lead bot on marketing pages (not a live LLM chat).
Public API: POST https://aikova.co.uk/api/mcl-capture-lead
Fields: name, email, company?, interest, urgency, source_page (honeypot: website).
Leads land in Admin CRM collection `leads` with source `MCL Bot`.
